Installation

bun
Copy
bunx shadcn@latest add @modulo/elastic-slider

Requires an active Modulo key and a project configured for shadcn.

Registry setup
Usage
import { ElasticSlider } from "@/components/elastic-slider/ElasticSlider";

export default function Example() {
  return <ElasticSlider label="Brightness" defaultValue={65} orientation="vertical" />;
}

React and scoped CSS. No animation package required.

Registry JSONDownload thumbnailDownload preview GIFDownload preview video
Interaction

Drag horizontally or vertically. The value stays within its bounds while the shell stretches at either end. Labels, content, and input targets keep their shape.

Arrow keys adjust one step. Page Up and Page Down adjust ten steps. Home and End select the bounds. Step rounding starts at the minimum.

Changes arrive during adjustment. A successful pointer release or keyboard release commits the requested value. Cancellation settles the shell without a commit. Controlled values remain owned by the parent.

Reduced motion preserves value adjustment without elastic stretching. Preference changes, hidden tabs, and unmounting stop pending animation and replay.

API
Prop	Type	Default
label
Visible and accessible name for the value.
	string	Required
value / defaultValue
Use value with onValueChange for controlled state, or defaultValue for local state.
	number	min
min / max
Finite ordered semantic bounds.
	number	0 / 100
step
Value increment counted from min, or continuous pointer values with any.
	number | "any"	1
orientation
Input direction and shell layout.
	"horizontal" | "vertical"	"horizontal"
disabled
Blocks pointer and keyboard changes.
	boolean	false
reducedMotion
Requests a still alternate path. The system preference also applies.
	boolean	false
onValueChange
Bounded normalized value requests. Required with controlled value.
	(value: number) => void	Optional
onValueCommit
Successful user adjustment. Cancellation does not commit.
	(value: number) => void	Optional
formatValue
Formats the displayed and accessible value.
	(value: number) => string	Optional
children
Rigid decorative content outside shell deformation.
	ReactNode	Optional
onReady
Controller on mount and null on cleanup. Keep callback stable.
	(controller | null) => void	Optional

Installation
npm

bun
Copy
bunx shadcn@latest add @modulo/snap-rail

Requires an active Modulo key and a project configured for shadcn.

Registry setup
Usage
import { SnapRail } from "@/components/snap-rail/SnapRail";

const detents = [
  { id: "left", label: "Left", position: 0 },
  { id: "center", label: "Center", position: 140 },
  { id: "right", label: "Right", position: 280 },
];

export default function Example() {
  return <SnapRail ariaLabel="Placement" detents={detents} defaultSelectedId="center" />;
}

React and browser Pointer Events. All four source files install together. No animation package required.

Registry JSONDownload thumbnailDownload preview GIFDownload preview video
Interaction

Drag the item horizontally. Release speed projects a destination, then the item springs to the nearest detent. Grab it again to interrupt. A hold before release discards stale flick speed.

Use the destination buttons, arrow keys, Home or End. Labels stay rigid. Cancellation returns to the selected detent without committing. Reduced motion selects the destination immediately. Hidden and offscreen previews stop animation.

The spring tuning and projection are original examples. They are not Apple implementation constants.

API
Prop	Type	Default
detents
Stable IDs, labels, and increasing finite relative positions mapped across the track.
	readonly SnapDetent[]	Required
ariaLabel
Accessible name of the placement control.
	string	"Snap position"
selectedId / defaultSelectedId
Controlled selection or initial local selection.
	string	First detent
onSelectionChange
Selection requests. Required with controlled selectedId.
	(id: string) => void	Optional
onSelectionCommit
Successful user destination request.
	(id: string) => void	Optional
onSelectionCancel
Canceled pointer interaction without a commit.
	() => void	Optional
decaySeconds
Projection time constant in seconds.
	number	0.12
hysteresis
Preview midpoint margin in pixels.
	number	8
omega / dampingRatio
Illustrative spring tuning, not Apple constants.
	number	20 / 0.85
disabled / reducedMotion
Input availability and still alternate path.
	boolean	false
onReady
Controller on mount and null on cleanup. Keep callback stable.
	(controller | null) => void	Optional

Installation
npm

Copy
bunx shadcn@latest add @modulo/liquid-cluster

Requires an active Modulo key and a project configured for shadcn.

Registry setup
Usage
import { LiquidCluster } from "@/components/liquid-cluster/LiquidCluster";

const items = [{ id: "left", label: "Left" }, { id: "center", label: "Center" }, { id: "right", label: "Right" }];

export default function Example() {
  return <LiquidCluster ariaLabel="Alignment" items={items} defaultSelectedId="center" defaultSeparation={0.65} />;
}

React and Canvas 2D. All three source files install together. No animation package required.

Registry JSONDownload thumbnailDownload preview GIFDownload preview video
Interaction

Choose a labeled action with a click, Enter, or Space. Each button keeps its own target, accessible name, and selection state while the background shapes join.

Separation ranges from 0 for joined shapes to 1 for separated shapes. Available space determines the gap in pixels. Join and Separate update the same value. A new value retargets the current spring.

Reduced motion applies the final geometry directly. Opaque background removes transparency and the shared shadow. Native buttons remain available if Canvas cannot render or the labels need to wrap.

The background uses geometric smooth-union blending. It is an original adaptation of proximity merging, with no physical fluid simulation or optical refraction.

API
Prop	Type	Default
items
Unique IDs, labels, and optional per-item disabled state.
	readonly LiquidClusterItem[]	Required
ariaLabel
Accessible name of the related button group.
	string	Required
separation / defaultSeparation
Normalized gap from 0 to 1. Controlled separation requires onSeparationChange.
	number	0.65
onSeparationChange
Requested normalized separation.
	(value: number) => void	Optional
selectedId / defaultSelectedId
Controlled or initial local active button. Controlled selection requires onSelect.
	string | null	null
onSelect
Independent button activation.
	(id: string) => void	Optional
disabled
Disables all native button targets.
	boolean	false
opaque
Requests an opaque material adaptation.
	boolean	false
reducedMotion
Disables automatic settling. System preference also applies.
	boolean	false
onReady
Controller on mount and null on cleanup. Keep callback stable.
	(controller | null) => void	Optional
